Mitthan vs State Of U.P. And Another on 18 January, 2023
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Court No. - 85
Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 11444 of 2022
Applicant :- Mitthan

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Irshad Ahmad
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Mrs. Jyotsna Sharma,J.
1.

Heard Sri Irshad Ahmad, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri O.P. Mishra, learned Aga for the
State and perused the papers on record.

2. The present application has been moved on behalf of the applicant-Mitthan seeking anticipatory
bail in Case Crime no. 212 of 2022, under Section 323, 498A, 304B I.P.C. and 3/4 of Dowry
Prohibition Act, P.S. Hayat Nagar, District Sambhal.

entities.text:
Dowry
Prohibition Act, P.S. Hayat Nagar
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
3.  As per prosecution case, the deceased sister of the informant was harassed by her father in-law,
mother in-law and her husband for fulfilling their demand of dowry; the matter was resolved by holding a panchayat and executing a compromise deed in writing dated 21.08.2022; she was pregnant and she informed the first informant crying on a phone call that she is not been taken to the hospital though she is quite unwell.
On 21.09.2022, she delivered a child and died.
It is alleged in the FIR that she died of torture by her in-laws.

4. It is contended on behalf of the applicant that she died at the time of delivery of the child and that her death cannot be categorized as one in unnatural circumstances in the sense as finds place in Section 304-B IPC.

My attention has been drawn to the inquest and the postmortem report to stress the fact that she sustained no external injuries and that presence of clinical tape on her left hand indicated that she was given medical assistance.

It is further contended that she in fact died in Mitthan vs State Of U.P. And Another on 18 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/119121035/
1 hospital, therefore, it cannot be said that no medical assistance was provided.
5.

entities.text: Mitthan vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 6. I considered the nature of accusation, all the attending facts and circumstances of the case and material before me.
It may be kept in mind that anticipatory bail is an extraordinary remedy to be exercised in suitable cases only.
The power under Section 438 Cr.P.C. cannot be utilized in a routine manner and definitely not as a substitute for regular bail.

This discretionary power calls for existence of facts of the kind where the court is satisfied that its interference is necessary to further the cause of justice and to prevent misuse of process of law.
7. In view of the facts and circumstances of the case I do not find it fit case to grant benefit of anticipatory bail.
8. Hence the anticipatory bail application is rejected.
9. It is made clear that observations made herein shall not in any way affect the learned trial Judge in forming his independent opinion at any stage of the case based on material before him.
